name: Secrets of the Path
source:
Aubrey is a lonely sort. When his friend from work invites him to a weekend camping trip as a plus one, he's happy to accept. But will this trip really be as fun as it seems, or is something deeper going on beneath the surface?

[From [url=https://knowit01.itch.io/secrets-of-the-path]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
奥布里是一个孤独的人。当他的工作朋友邀请他参加周末露营旅行时，他很高兴地接受了。但这趟旅行真的像看起来那么有趣吗？还是表面之下隐藏着更深层次的事情？

[来自[url=https://knowit01.itch.io/secrets-of-the-path]Itch.io[/url]]
